last_sync.summary: Human-reviewed manual recovery audit for VE Analyze strategy filters and recovery state. Source evidence is pinned at [firmware/CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/capoworks/capoworks-ecu/blob/825d7fda5c32b7ec3f755be4897775819e8605d1/firmware/CHANGELOG.md); guide target for a separate docs PR: docs/08-Fuel/Fuel-Settings/VE-Analyze.md (not claimed public here).
